Premise: code read on origin/main fc5913e117. A live repro in a real 380 px drawer is owed before code (seat: showcase and CRM). The card's forced inline width may not be the mechanism. The synthesized default page measures its own container (`useRecordPageTier`, RecordDetailView.tsx ~:1203-1219). An authored ("hand-written") page "is drawn as authored, so it never measures". The authored page renderer `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` lays its regions out on VIEWPORT breakpoints: the body row is `flex flex-col md:flex-row` (~:428), and sidebar/aside widths are `w-full md:w-64|w-80|w-96` (`getSidebarWidthClass`, :62). So in a 380 px drawer on a 1280 px viewport, a page with a sidebar or aside region keeps the row layout and squeezes `main` to the remainder. Candidate cause, NOT yet measured. Candidate fix: put those classes on the page root's container (`@container` / `@md:`), so the drawer and the full page each follow their own width. If the real drawer does not reproduce on an authored page with a rail region (showcase pages; CRM / HotCRM opportunity), the dev reports the method and the reading, and the seat closes the card with the filer. The card's second check also applies: a column re-layout when the container widens after open.
Serial constraints cleared: `overlap-check probe of page.tsx vs origin/main fc5913e117: clean exit 0, 0 open PR heads`
Pre-claim lane: `domain:ui`. Moved from o3-A to o3-B by seat 3 (15:15Z). o3-A holds no claim: no assignee and no `Claim:` comment.
Pre-claim deps: no `Blocked-by:`
Prior rulings read: container query,page template,sidebar region,aside region,record drawer,authored page → 0 hits; none; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack. Also #34696 (narrow-drawer path, the 380 px rig) and #27524 / #26678 (the default page laid out by its container width).
